recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Additional EUDAMED safety codes should be handled separately under FHIR-40909 or a terminology follow-up once the code system question is resolved.
issue_request: FHIR-11110 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Device after the DSTU2 ballot. It requested a repeatable Device characteristic element to convey MRI safety information.
initial_application: Historical commit 6af0b8c30aa11aac02a776420fb44ef2b080e463, tagged "[#11111],[#11110]", added Device.safety as a 0..* summary CodeableConcept and seeded the device-safety list with MRI safety concepts. Commit 1e5bec1a6e8e5358b8a96b1309c57d8d7acbcf3c then updated the safety codes and split the ValueSet source, explicitly referencing FHIR-11110.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Device.safety element remains 0..* CodeableConcept, isSummary=true, and is bound to the active device-safety ValueSet. The ValueSet includes Magnetic Resonance Safe, Conditional, Unsafe, and missing-information concepts. Later FHIR-32573 added the explicit Device.safety binding to the same ValueSet.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the current authoritative source already conveys the requested Device MRI safety characteristic support.

related_jiras.note: Latex safety was applied in the same Device.safety commit and uses the same value set.
This later Published issue added the explicit Device.safety example binding to the device-safety ValueSet.
This later issue proposes additional EUDAMED examples but is not Applied/Published and remains pending terminology input.
